text: Gold and silver trade in choppy ranges after an extreme one-day drawdown. Silver slips about 0.3% near $78.70 after a 28% drop; gold falls roughly 3% near $4,707 after nearly 10% down Friday. CME raises COMEX margin requirements to 8% for gold and 15% for 5,000-oz silver. The dollar index is ~0.8% higher since Thursday; WTI crude is ~4% lower. Metals oscillate intraday without settling into a stable band.

meta.note: Boundary blur between macro pricing signals and market plumbing created channel tension.
